title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3509 — Color intensity.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The varying degree of saturation or chroma. Color intensity as applied to tobacco describes the strength or weakness of a specific color or hue. It is applicable to all colors except green. (See Elements of Quality, § 29.3586.).

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3510 — Color symbols.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). As applied to Dark Air-cured tobacco, color symbols are L—light brown, F—medium brown, R—reddish brown, D—dark brown, M—mixed, and G—green.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3511 — Condition.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The state of tobacco which results from the method of preparation or from the degree of fermentation. Words used to describe the condition of tobacco are: Undried, air-dried, steam-dried, sweating, sweated, and aged.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3512 — Crude.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). A subdegree of maturity. Crude leaves are usually hard and slick as a result of extreme immaturity. A similar condition may result from firekill, sunburn, or sunscald. Any leaf which is crude to the extent of 20 percent or more of its leaf surface.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3513 — Cured.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: United States law. Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). Tobacco dried of its sap by either natural or artificial processes.

creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The effect of mold, must, rot, black rot, or other fungus or bacterial diseases which attack tobacco in its cured state. Tobacco having the odor of mold, must, or rot is considered damaged. (See Rule 24, § 29.3625.).

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3515 — Dirty.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3516 — Elasticity.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The flexible, springy nature of the tobacco leaf to recover approximately its original size and shape after it has been stretched. (See Elements of Quality, § 29.3586.).

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3517 — Finish.
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The reflectance factor in color perception. Finish indicates the sheen or shine of the surface of a tobacco leaf. (See Elements of Quality, § 29.3586.).

creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). description: United States law. Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The stage of preparation of tobacco such as unstemmed or stemmed.

creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: United States law. Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). A subdivision of a type according to group, quality, and color.

description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). A grademark normally consists of three symbols which indicate group, quality, and color. A letter is used to indicate group, a number to indicate quality, and a letter or letters to indicate color. For example, B3D means Heavy Leaf, third quality, and dark-brown color.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3522 — Green (G).
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Any leaf which has a green color affecting 20 percent or more of its leaf surface may be described as green. (See Rule 19, § 29.3620.).

Groups in Dark Air-cured types are: Wrappers (A), Heavy Leaf (B), Thin Leaf (C), Lugs (X), Nondescript.

Injury to tobacco may be caused by field diseases, insects, or weather conditions; insecticides, fungicides, or cell growth inhibitors.

description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The degree of ripeness. (See Elements of Quality, § 29.3586, and Rule 16, § 29.3617.).

title: 7 C.F.R. § 29.3648 — Thin Leaf (C Group).
creator: Agricultural Marketing Service (Standards, Inspections, Marketing Practices), Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 29 (Tobacco Inspection). description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 3560 (Direct Multi-Family Housing Loans And Grants). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). Generally, the Agency will provide the borrower prior notice of an on-site monitoring review and will conduct the on-site monitoring review in the presence of the borrower. However, the Agency may visit a housing project, without prior notice, to observe.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 3560.354 — Borrower response to monitoring review notifications.
creator: Rural Housing Service, Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 3560 (Direct Multi-Family Housing Loans And Grants). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The Agency will notify borrowers, in writing, whenever Agency monitoring activities result in deficiency findings or compliance violations. The monitoring review notification will describe the deficiencies findings or compliance violations and will specify a time period by which corrective action.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 3560.401 — General.
creator: Rural Housing Service, Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 3560 (Direct Multi-Family Housing Loans And Grants). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) Purpose. This subpart contains actions the Agency may take to service and collect loans or other debts owed by multi-family housing (MFH) borrowers. The loan servicing and other actions set forth are designed to protect Agency and tenant interests.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 3560.402 — Loan payment processing.
creator: Rural Housing Service, Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 3560 (Direct Multi-Family Housing Loans And Grants). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) Predetermined Amortization Schedule System (PASS) requirements. All loans, except the loans specified in paragraph (c) of this section, must be closed and serviced using the PASS. (b) Required conversion to PASS. Borrowers with Daily Interest Accrual System (DIAS) accounts.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 3560.403 — Account servicing.
creator: Rural Housing Service, Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 3560 (Direct Multi-Family Housing Loans And Grants). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) Payment due dates. Loan or other payments due to the Agency are due on the first day of each month unless otherwise established in the debt instrument or other agreement executed with the Agency. (b) Payment application order. Loan.

title: 7 C.F.R. § 3560.404 — Final loan payments.
creator: Rural Housing Service, Department Of Agriculture
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 7 (Agriculture), Part 3560 (Direct Multi-Family Housing Loans And Grants). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). (a) Payoff statements. At the borrower's request, the Agency will provide a statement indicating the pay off amount necessary to pay the borrower's account in full. (b) Final payments. A borrower's final loan payment must include repayment of all outstanding.
